additional_fixture_repair.fact: The method assumes the actual historical ignored run directory exists under ROOT; replay raw files alone do not create it. With an empty checkout, reaper returns existed=False and the deliberate no-GPU-probe callback is reached.
additional_fixture_repair.fixture_scope: Ordinary local owned filesystem precondition; no historical run output or live Docker/model installation.
additional_fixture_repair.minimum_remedy: Create one owned TemporaryDirectory and runs/nonpublication/V2_RUN_ID directory, map observed captured mount sources to this exact temporary root, and pass it to the original reaper/mutating-phase. Retain status78, exact four reaped CID hashes, no create/start and no GPU/worker launch assertions.

clarification: The replay family mixes in-process scripted runners, mock process objects and genuine owned fake-CLI/Python subprocess watchdog tests. Keep every real process/pipe/cleanup boundary; no real Docker daemon, inference or model authority is needed.
